principle_violations.reason: The UserService class directly depends on a concrete implementation of the MySQLDatabase, violating the dependency inversion principle. High-level modules like UserService should not depend on low-level modules like MySQLDatabase.
principle_violations.suggestion: Introduce an interface for the database operations and let UserService depend on the interface rather than a concrete implementation. This allows for easier substitution of different database implementations and adheres to the Dependency Inversion Principle.

overall_feedback: 1 principle violation found. Please see the details below.
